capabilities: Browse folders and notes in a two-pane vertical or horizontal layout
Preview note text, dates, tags, aliases, properties, and thumbnails in the file list
Filter notes with boolean, exact-phrase, fuzzy, tag, and vault-wide search
Multi-select notes to move, pin, or delete them with mouse, keyboard, or touch
Create folder notes, show note counts, custom icons, and excluded folders
extras: The README links to a third-party video walkthrough by Antone Heyward and lists release notes and contact channels separately.
intentEvidence: The default Obsidian explorer puts every folder and every file into one long tree.
problem: Obsidian's default file explorer puts every folder and file in one long tree that becomes hard to scan in large vaults.

relations.evidence: Install the Style Settings plugin to change font sizes and colors

summary: Two-pane file explorer that splits folders and notes into separate views, with note previews, search, pinning, and multi-select.
